Most of my current research is based in the **Western Indian Ocean**, particularly in **Madagascar**, and is supported by two major projects: [**ARMS Resilience**](projects/2025-ARMS_resilience/index.qmd) in Madagascar and [**MESCAL**](projects/2025-mescal/index.qmd), which spans the eastern coast of Africa, including South Africa, Mozambique, Tanzania, and Kenya. For more details, visit my [Projects Page](projects/).

Below is my list of research articles.
